title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Saturday, 19 September 2026
description: Today: Z.ai launches its multimodal GLM-5.3-Flash as Shanghai Biren weighs a $1bn share placement; a fatal shark attack in Perth reignites the beach safety debate as south-east Australia swings from cold to heat; Queensland investigates a fatal Noosa crash as Rockhampton's CapriCon turns 10; and the Gold Coast's Crafted Beer Festival and Gold Coast 500 build-up bring the weekend to life. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
